description: This file defines a serializable struct named MemoryMessageData for representing messages in an in-memory queue stream within Orleans. It includes properties such as StreamId, SequenceNumber, DequeueTimeUtc, EnqueueTimeUtc, and Payload, along with a static factory method Create.

classes.name: MemoryMessageData
classes.description: A struct representing the data for messages sent and received from an in-memory stream queue, including metadata such as stream ID, sequence number, timestamps, and payload.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a MemoryMessageData with a provided StreamId and payload, setting the EnqueueTimeUtc to the current UTC time.
